method: parallel researcher-web agents restricted to official government immigration sources; 'verified' = fact read from the official page; 'not_found' = not verifiable from allowed sources in this research (NOT proof of absence); blocked pages recorded honestly
notes: These findings are REFERENCE facts for human review. They never auto-approve or auto-reject any RAD claim.
All linked ledger claims remain REVIEW_REQUIRED pending owner-approved human review.

Several official sites (UDI, Migri, France-Visas, UGE, AIMA, BMI, Göç İdaresi, Malaysia Immigration, Home Affairs subpages) blocked automated retrieval; those entries carry verification_state 'blocked_or_not_found'.

findings.facts: Current route is the Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte, section 2a AufenthG), replacing the previous job-seeker visa; up to 12 months, up to 20h/week work; points-based (min 6) or direct route with fully recognized qualification; blocked account ~EUR 1,091/month (2026 figure on official page).

No passive-investment residence visa and no golden visa/citizenship-by-investment found in official sources; only self-employment route exists; naturalisation after 5 years legal residence (nationality law reform effective 2024-06-27).

Skilled Immigration Act (FEG) phased from Nov 2023; skilled-worker route needs recognized/comparable qualification + job offer; EU Blue Card 2026 thresholds EUR 45,934.20 (shortage/new entrants) and EUR 50,700; settlement permit timelines: 3y general skilled, 27/21mo Blue Card (A1/B1), 2y German graduates; EU long-term residence at 5y.

Unqualified 'free tuition at public universities' is too broad; official sources reviewed did not establish a complete current state-by-state fee list (Baden-Württemberg/Bavaria fees not verified here); check per-university fee schedules.

Study permit needs LOA from DLI + PAL/TAL (most cases), funds: CAD 22,895 first-year living expenses (applications 2025-01-01..2026-08-31; rises to 23,448 from 2026-09-01) plus tuition and travel; Quebec separate. SDS DISCONTINUED 2024-11-08 14:00 ET. PGWP: language CLB/NCLC 7 (university programs) or 5 (college) for applications on/after 2024-11-01; field-of-study restrictions for non-degree graduates applying on/after that date.

Express Entry manages CEC/FSW/FST; CRS out of 1,200; job-offer CRS points removed 2025-03-25; category-based selection categories published; FSW: TEER 0-3, 1yr/1,560h within 10 years, 67/100 selection factors, settlement funds; PNP adds 600 CRS points (QC and Nunavut excluded).

Federal Immigrant Investor Program TERMINATED by legislation 2014-06-19 (no passive investor visa since). Start-up Visa PAUSED 2026-06-30 (limited过渡 with 2025 commitment certificates). Self-employedPersons program intake paused since 2024-04-30 (cultural/athletic only anyway).

Spousal/partner sponsorship: sponsor 18+, citizen/PR; generally no minimum income for spouse/child sponsorship. Citizenship: 1,095 days physical presence in 5 years before applying, incl. 730 days as PR; half-day credit for certain temporary-resident time (max 365).

Tier 4 (General) replaced by Student visa; CAS from licensed sponsor; maintenance GBP 1,529/month London or 1,171/month outside London (max 13,761/10,539 for 9 months) held 28 consecutive days ending within 31 days of application; Iran NOT on differential-evidence list.

Skilled Worker: sponsored employer, threshold GBP 41,700/year or going rate (whichever higher), exceptions exist; Shortage Occupation List replaced by Immigration Salary List (published 2024-04-04); Graduate visa: 2y (applications <=2026-12-31), 18mo from 2027-01-01, 3y doctoral; cannot be extended.

Tier 1 (Investor) CLOSED to new applicants 2022-02-17; Start-up closed; Innovator Founder visa exists (endorsed active business, NOT passive investment). No current UK route granting residence purely for investment.

Partner visa minimum income GBP 29,000 (exceptions; GBP 18,600 for extensions of pre-2024-04-11 applications); settlement commonly 5-year route. Naturalisation: 5 years residence + 12 months with ILR/settled (spouse of British citizen: 3 years + ILR, no 12-month wait).

EB-5 exists (real residency-by-investment route): minimum USD 1,050,000, or USD 800,000 in TEA/infrastructure (petitions filed on/after 2022-03-15; first inflation adjustment 2027-01-01); conditional LPR then I-829; RIA 2022 set-asides (20% rural, 10% high-unemployment, 2% infrastructure); Regional Center authorized through 2027-09-30; no verified current wait estimate.

EB-1/EB-2(+NIW)/EB-3 employment green cards as described by USCIS; DV lottery: Iran NOT excluded for DV-2026 (eligibility by country of birth; selection not a visa guarantee); F-1 study with CPT/OPT (OPT generally 12mo + 24mo STEM); H-1B needs US employer petitioner, caps 65,000 + 20,000 advanced-degree; naturalisation general route requires 913 days (30 months) physical presence in statutory 5-year period.

Student visa (500): CoE, OSHC, GS requirement replaced GTE for applications from 2024-03-23; financial capacity AUD 29,710/year primary applicant (+tuition+travel). Skilled: 189/190/491 points-tested via SkillSelect EOI (general 65-point threshold), occupation lists per visa/stream. 482 TSS replaced by Skills in Demand 2024-12-07 (Specialist/Core/Labour Agreement streams). 485 graduate: streams with 2-3y / up to 18mo typical, age<=35 general from 2024 changes.

Business Innovation & Investment Program (incl. subclass 188) CLOSED to new applications 2024-07-31; no currently open passive investor/golden visa. Citizenship: 4 years lawful residence immediately before application incl. 12 months as PR, absence limits apply.

Sweden work permit requires employment first (job offer); study permit: tuition paid before application where due, application fee SEK 1,500 adults; NO investor/golden visa category found among official routes; claim that non-EU tuition fees began Sept 2024 NOT FOUND in Migrationsverket material (historical date not shown).

Denmark Green Card (grønkort) scheme ABOLISHED by Act No. 612 of 2016-06-08, in force 2016-06-10. Pay Limit scheme exists (job offer required, DKK 552,000/year minimum, 2026 level). Study permit: admission, full-time, funds DKK 7,426/month (2026 level).

Norway UDI and Finland Migri official pages could not be retrieved in this research (access errors). No dedicated passive-investor visa identified in material located, but NOT conclusively verified. Finland start-up permit exists for active entrepreneurs (Business Finland eligibility statement) — not a passive-investor visa; full current criteria UNVERIFIED here.

Official pages for France (france-visas 403), Spain (UGE 403), Portugal (AIMA cert error), Austria (BMI), Turkey (Göç İdaresi), Malaysia (Immigration) could not be read in this research. Italy: Investor Visa for Italy programme EXISTS (2017 Foreign Ministry framework) — current minimum amounts UNVERIFIED here. No golden-visa status certified for the blocked countries in this run.
